text: The Patriots head to Buffalo for their Week 4 matchup against Josh Allen and the Bills facing a depleted defensive front, as both Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore have been ruled out due to shoulder injuries, forcing Mike Reiss to analyze how New England will adjust its lineup on that side of the ball. The offensive line situation hasn't improved matters either, with guard Greg Van Roten placed on injured reserve due to a thigh injury, continuing the infrastructure challenges around quarterback Drake Maye, who insisted Wednesday that his own right shoulder remains fine and that better decision-making—not physical limitations—is what he needs to address the Patriots' 1-2 start. On a brighter note, wide receiver Mack Hollins was named the Week 4 NFLPA Community MVP after hosting a Special Olympics Family Field Day for over 100 athletes and their families, while the Patriots also added offensive line depth by signing Matt Pryor to the roster, even as expert predictions begin circulating ahead of Sunday's showdown with a Bills team featuring a quarterback known for bouncing back from sloppy performances.
